old: Wide shot from a gravel footpath across an open San Francisco public square in June 1907, one fully grown middle-aged resident with a lined face and broad shoulders in a plain early-1900s wool coat and brimmed hat studies a row of small low single-storey wooden relief cottages standing on bare ground, only open ground, these cottages and sky fill the background, soft overcast light
new: Medium close shot inside a San Francisco public-square relief camp in June 1907, one fully grown middle-aged resident with a lined face and broad shoulders in a plain early-1900s wool coat and brimmed hat studies the doorway of one small low single-storey wooden relief cottage beside him; the cottage's simple timber wall and low roof fill the background, a narrow strip of bare ground at his feet, soft overcast light
